body:
## Pull request overview This PR restructures Hazel so `util`/`language`/`haz3lcore` no longer depend on js_of_ocaml/Vdom, and introduces a new native Notty-based terminal UI (`tui.exe`) that reuses the shared core editing pipeline. **Changes:** - Split web-only utilities, effect handlers, and projector views into `src/web/`, with injection points in core (`TimeUtil.now_ms`, probe focus handler, projector focusables). - Add a new native TUI library/executable (`src/tui/`) plus a headless replay driver and golden/input tests. - Split test execution into native (`haz3ltest.exe`) vs web/node (`haz3ltest_web.bc.js`) runners and update scripts/rules accordingly. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 157 out of 177 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.
